object: M99-EXTERNAL-CAMPAIGN-RUNNER-001, the local-first workspace, evidence hashing, observation, finalization, verification, and proposed-ledger-amendment instrument for all ten campaigns that control Manzanita public release.
mechanism: The runner initializes one exact held campaign from the ten-class contract, records the accountable operator and actual venue, hashes evidence with rights and scope while private bytes remain local, records only contract-admitted observation types, exposes every missing requirement and failed digest, permits PASSED only after complete passing observations and evidence verification, emits a deterministic bounded public receipt, verifies that receipt and optional readback bytes, and creates a proposed one-row release-ledger amendment that still requires separate release-authority review.

evidence.claim: Defines all ten external campaign objects, actors, venue requirements, observation types, evidence classes, pass criteria, prohibited claims, authority boundaries, and no-standing law.
Operates local workspaces, evidence hashing, observations, exact status, strict finalization, receipt verification, bounded proposed ledger amendments, and runner qualification.

Exercises complete and incomplete campaigns, evidence and receipt tampering, missing evidence linkage, deterministic receipts, private-path omission, symlink refusal, held outcomes, dynamic ledger qualification, and exactly one bounded proposed amendment.
Defines the operator sequence, private-evidence boundary, transaction semantics, and controlling question.
Binds the exact ten campaign identities, source manifest, canonical ledger state, actual passed and open counts, no-campaign qualification state, no physical standing, and authority firewalls.
Supplies the canonical campaign identities and current states that a real passed receipt may only propose to amend.
Defines why the external campaigns control public release and preserves separate release-authority review.
Binds exact-head path scope, contracts, Python compilation, adversarial tests, runner qualification, contained review, authority assertions, and artifact retention to the submitted head.
Defines the twelve contained review seats, evidence minimums, gate and veto law, authority boundary, and non-external review claim.

claim_boundary: This packet requests internal runner admission only. It does not request or imply that any assistive-technology, human, device, network, private, provider, field, archive, endpoint, or rollback campaign occurred, passed, changed the canonical ledger, authorized public release, created an external effect, earned a score, or closed a canonical task row.

continuity.recovery_path: Recover the contract and runner, initialize a fresh operator-controlled workspace, replay a retained campaign receipt with available evidence bytes, verify its digest, and compare any proposed ledger amendment without modifying the canonical ledger.

control_question: Can an accountable operator perform one named external campaign, retain every required observation and evidence class, verify exact bytes, record acceptance and failure disposition, and produce a receipt that release authority can review without exposing private evidence or inventing physical standing?
